info.title: Agent Data Tools
info.description: Focused subset of the Agent Data Tools API (full spec with ~700 tools: https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/openapi.json). Pay-per-call data and document tools for agents: web, PDF and office files to text, invoice field extraction, EU VAT and company registers, chain reads and prices. Unpaid requests return 402 with x402 v2 terms (USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum) and MPP challenges. Failed calls are not charged.

get.summary: Scrape website page to Markdown: page URL into clean Markdown or text for LLMs
get.description: Fetch any public web page URL and get clean, LLM-ready text or Markdown: main content, code blocks, tables, links and headings, for RAG and agent context. Static HTML, Markdown or text; optional section ID. Default 20,000 output characters, max 100,000; input 2 MiB. No JavaScript rendering (see /extract/rendered), logins or paywalls. Empty pages, bad sections, browser challenges and errors are not charged. Use to read docs or articles. Details: HTML body details share a 20,000-character budget, independently of primary text/Markdown. Up to 20 code blocks, 20 tables (100 rows/20 cells each), 100 headings and 200 links. Spans/ragged tables use labelled TSV in Markdown; spans are not expanded. HTML code whitespace and list hierarchy are preserved; generated code fences are closed within the output limit. Other Markdown syntax may be incomplete after clipping. Hashes cover the returned hashFormat, not full source. linkBaseUrl reports static source link resolution; supported first HTML base href values are honored, with warnings. Scripts and CSP are not evaluated. Markdown sources retain syntax without structured parsing (warned); sections require HTML. Source content is untrusted. Image alt text is source-provided, not visual interpretation. Images are never fetched; SVG/canvas omissions and missing alt descriptions are warned. SourceMetadata adds unverified author/date declarations with provenance; conflicting/ambiguous values are warned. Separate 2,000-character metadata budget, 5 authors/10 dates. JSON-LD: at most 8 inline scripts, 64 KiB each, 100 graph nodes/depth 8; no external contexts/profiles. HTML complexity: 20,000 elements/128 nested levels. Marker-only source permalink controls (pilcrow/headerlink/permalink classes) are omitted only for same-document ancestor targets, with permalink_controls_omitted. Literal code and ordinary references remain. HTML sup/sub annotations normalize to ^{...}/_{...} in primary output, heading titles and table values with superscript_subscript_normalized; literal pre/code and raw Markdown stay unchanged. This is notation preservation, not general math interpretation.

externalDocs.description: Read a public documentation page for $0.002

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to fetch

parameters.name: maxChars
parameters.description: Maximum characters of body text to return (500-100000, default 20000)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Returned representation: text (default), markdown, or both. HTML structured details are included in every format; Markdown/plain sources have empty details.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Optional exact visible HTML ID within primary content, 1-500 characters. Heading scope includes subsections until next same/higher-level heading; section/article/main/div scope is its subtree. Missing/ambiguous/unsupported targets fail uncharged. URL fragments alone do not select a section.

sourceMetadata.description: Page-level source declarations, not verified authorship or freshness. Head author/Open Graph date tags and bounded direct Schema.org JSON-LD Article/WebPage-like nodes only; exact-URL matches preferred, otherwise only one identity-free candidate. Author @id references resolve only to unambiguous local Person/Organization names, with both paths recorded. No external context/reference fetching or general JSON-LD expansion. Separate 2000-character value+provenance budget; 5 authors/10 dates. Original date strings are not normalized. Empty for Markdown/plain sources; unrelated entities and ambiguous nodes are omitted with warnings.

linkBaseUrl.description: Effective source-derived HTTP(S) base for links: the first supported HTML base href outside inert/foreign subtrees, otherwise finalUrl. Credentials and non-HTTP(S) base values are ignored with a warning. HTML links/canonical use this base; raw Markdown keeps relative syntax and can be resolved using this field. No linked resource is fetched. This static interpretation does not evaluate scripts or Content Security Policy.

sourceFormat.description: Source interpretation. Markdown is identified by text/markdown, or a .md/.markdown final path served as text/plain (warned). Markdown syntax is retained verbatim within the cap, not converted to HTML or parsed for structured details; text also retains that syntax. HTML section IDs are unsupported for Markdown/plain text.

textLength.description: Full extracted text length before the character cap, within the input limit.

truncated.description: Input or requested primary representation is incomplete. Structured detail limits are reported separately in warnings.

id.description: Source HTML heading ID or direct child anchor ID, when present and supported; not a generated slug.

section.description: Null for full primary-content reading. Otherwise the explicitly requested scope; title/description/canonical remain page-level metadata. Heading scope ends before the next same/higher-level heading, including nested subsections; container scope is its subtree.

get.summary: Web page to Markdown, rendered: a JavaScript-rendered page as text or Markdown
get.description: Same output as /extract, but the page is first rendered in a real browser, so single-page apps and pages that build their content with JavaScript come back with their text instead of an empty shell. Waits for the network to settle (up to 15 seconds). Public pages only; no login. Use when /extract returns EXTRACTION_EMPTY or too little text for a page you can read in a browser.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the page

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: text (default), markdown or both

parameters.name: maxChars
parameters.description: Output limit, 500-100000 characters (default 20000)

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Optional exact HTML id to read only that element

get.summary: PDF to text, PDF text extraction: extract the text of a PDF document from a URL, page by page
get.description: Extract the text of a public PDF (up to 10 MB) from its URL, page by page, with title, author and page count. Choose the first page, how many pages (up to 200) and maxChars. arXiv abstract links work. If a site blocks our fetch, the Internet Archive's dated copy is read and the answer says so. Scanned, encrypted and non-PDF files fail uncharged. Use to read papers, invoices, reports and manuals into an agent.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the PDF

parameters.name: firstPage
parameters.description: First page to read (default 1)

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: How many pages to read (1-200, default 20)

parameters.name: maxChars
parameters.description: Maximum characters of text returned across all pages (1000-200000, default 50000)

pages.text: Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System

get.summary: Document to text: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF
get.description: Convert a document to text or Markdown: Word (.docx) with headings, lists and tables, Excel (.xlsx) sheet by sheet, PowerPoint (.pptx) slide by slide, a PDF's text, and scanned PDFs or images (PNG, JPEG, WebP) by OCR. Give a public file's URL, or send the file in a POST body (10 MB; images 3 MB). Old .doc/.xls/.ppt and password-protected files fail uncharged. Use to read attachments, scans and spreadsheets into an agent, RAG or a workflow.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the file (or send the file in a POST body instead)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: markdown (default: headings, lists and tables kept) or text

parameters.name: maxChars
parameters.description: Maximum characters of text returned (1000-200000, default 50000)

get.summary: Extract data from a document: invoice, receipt, contract fields as JSON
get.description: Extract named fields from a document as JSON: give a PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint file, a scan or a photo (PNG, JPEG, WebP) by URL or in a POST body (up to 10 MB; images 3 MB) and the field names you want, such as invoice_number, total, due_date. An AI model reads the file, scans by OCR, and returns one JSON object, with null where a value is not stated. Use to turn invoices, receipts, orders and contracts into rows.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the file (or send the file in a POST body instead)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated field names to extract (1-30). For rows, give the row keys in brackets: line_items[description,quantity,amount]

data.title: Demonstration of DOCX support in calibre

get.summary: VAT number validation, EU VIES
get.description: Check an EU VAT number against the European Commission's VIES service: valid or not, with the registered name and address where the member state shares them. Any spacing (SE556703748501, DE 123 456 789; EL or GR for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland). Or verify a business by name: found or not in the French, Swedish, Norwegian and Finnish registers. Use to check a B2B customer before invoicing without VAT, or to confirm a supplier.

parameters.name: vat
parameters.description: VAT number with its 2-letter EU country prefix (give vat or name)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name to verify instead of a VAT number: found or not in the FR, SE, NO and FI company registers

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: With name: search only this register (FR, SE, NO or FI, or the country's name)

get.summary: Swedish company lookup, Bolagsverket register
get.description: Swedish company by organisationsnummer (556703-7485 or SE556703748501) or name, from Bolagsverket and SCB: names, legal form, registration date, status, deregistration, bankruptcy, liquidation or reconstruction, VAT/F-tax/employer activity, SNI codes, business description, address. Weekly open data. Use to verify a Swedish customer or supplier before invoicing. Register facts only, not a credit report.

parameters.name: orgnr
parameters.description: Swedish organisationsnummer (10 digits, with or without the hyphen) or Swedish VAT number (give orgnr or name)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name to search for, instead of orgnr: up to 10 registered companies whose name holds every word

parameters.name: checkVat
parameters.description: true to also check the VAT number live in the EU VIES service (adds about a second)

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: With name: only companies whose postal address is in this city (postort), such as Göteborg

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Matches for a name search (1-10, default 5)

example.name: Spotify AB
example.businessDescription: Bolaget har till föremål för sin verksamhet att bedriva Internetrelaterade tjänster inom digitala medier som musik, spel och TV, samt att, direkt eller indirekt, äga och förvalta fast och lös egendom, äga aktier och andelar i dotterbolag och andra bolag samt tillhandahålla administrativa tjänster för dessa bolag och därmed förenlig verksamhet.
example.source: Bolagsverket and SCB open data (värdefulla datamängder), weekly bulk files
example.note: Register facts only. This is not a credit report, credit score or rating.

get.summary: Norwegian company lookup, Brønnøysund register
get.description: Norwegian company by organisasjonsnummer (923609016 or NO923609016MVA) or name, live from Brønnøysundregistrene: name, former names, legal form, status, bankruptcy, liquidation or reconstruction, registration and founding dates, VAT and business-register status, employees, industry codes, purpose, address, website. Use to verify a Norwegian customer or supplier. Register facts only, not a credit report.

parameters.name: orgnr
parameters.description: Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (9 digits) or VAT number NO…MVA (give orgnr or name)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name to search for, instead of orgnr: up to 10 companies whose name holds every word

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: With name: only companies whose address is in this city (poststed)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Matches for a name search (1-10, default 5)

example.name: EQUINOR ASA

industries.description: Produksjon av raffinerte petroleumsprodukter og fossile brenselsprodukter

example.purpose: Å utvikle, produsere og markedsføre ulike former for energi, avledede produkter og tjenester, samt annen virksomhet. Virksomheten kan også drives gjennom deltakelse i eller i samarbeid med andre selskaper.
example.note: Register facts only. This is not a credit report, credit score or rating.

get.summary: Finnish company lookup, PRH trade register
get.description: Finnish company by business ID (Y-tunnus 0112038-9 or VAT FI01120389) or name, live from the Finnish Patent and Registration Office (PRH): names incl. parallel and former, legal form, status, bankruptcy, liquidation or re-organisation, registration date, trade, VAT and employer registers, main business line, address, website. Use to verify a Finnish customer or supplier. Register facts only, not a credit report.

parameters.name: businessId
parameters.description: Finnish business ID (Y-tunnus, 1234567-8) or VAT number FI12345678 (give businessId or name)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name to search for, instead of businessId: up to 10 current companies whose name holds every word

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: With name: only companies registered in this town (Finnish or Swedish name)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Matches for a name search (1-10, default 5)

example.name: Nokia Oyj
example.source: Finnish Patent and Registration Office (PRH), YTJ open data (CC BY 4.0)
example.note: Register facts only. This is not a credit report, credit score or rating.

get.summary: French company lookup, Sirene register
get.description: French company by SIREN (552032534), SIRET or VAT number (FR27552032534), or by name, live from the State's company search API (INSEE Sirene and the RNE): name, acronym, legal form, active or ceased, creation date, NAF industry code, workforce band, company size category, establishments, head office address, VAT number. Use to verify a French customer or supplier. Register facts only, not a credit report.

parameters.name: siren
parameters.description: SIREN (9 digits), SIRET (14 digits) or French VAT number FR… (give siren or name)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name to search for, instead of siren: up to 10 active companies

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: With name: only companies whose head office is in this town

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Matches for a name search (1-10, default 5)

example.name: DANONE
example.source: API Recherche d'entreprises (INSEE Sirene and INPI RNE), Licence Ouverte 2.0
example.note: Register facts only. This is not a credit report, credit score or rating.

get.summary: LEI lookup, legal entity identifier
get.description: Look up a Legal Entity Identifier from GLEIF: by 20-character LEI, or search by company name for up to 10 matches. Legal name, other names, entity status, category, jurisdiction, company register ID, legal and headquarters address, LEI registration status, issue, renewal and corroboration. Source: GLEIF (CC0). Use for KYB, counterparty checks, trade reporting and matching companies across systems.

parameters.name: lei
parameters.description: A 20-character LEI

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name to search, instead of lei

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Matches for a name search (1-10, default 5)

get.summary: Company data lookup: profile, identifiers and website from Wikidata
get.description: Facts about a company by name or Wikidata ID: official website, founding date, country, headquarters, industries, CEO, founders, parent, employee count, stock tickers and exchanges, and LEI, with Wikidata and Wikipedia links. Public domain data (CC0), best for established and listed companies. No match returns 422, uncharged. Use to enrich leads, vendors and counterparties or ground an answer about a company.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Company name to search for (give name or id)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Wikidata item ID such as Q60269744, instead of name

get.summary: Base balance, native coin
get.description: Native ETH balance (eth_getBalance) of any 0x wallet address on Base at the latest block, in wei and in ETH. Use to check whether a wallet can pay gas or a transfer; for ERC-20 tokens use base_token_balance, for all holdings at once use wallet_portfolio. A malformed address is rejected with 400, uncharged.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: 0x wallet or contract address

get.summary: Base ERC-20 balance
get.description: ERC-20 token balance of a wallet on Base (USDC, USDT, WETH or any token, via balanceOf): raw amount, decimals, symbol and the human-readable amount, live from the token contract. Use to check stablecoin or token holdings before a transfer or trade; for the native coin use base_balance. Both inputs are 0x addresses (40 hex characters); no contract or a non-ERC-20 contract returns 422, uncharged.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token: a ticker such as USDC, USDT, WETH or DAI, or the 0x ERC-20 contract address

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: 0x wallet address

get.summary: Ethereum balance, native coin
get.description: Native ETH balance (eth_getBalance) of any 0x wallet address on Ethereum at the latest block, in wei and in ETH. Use to check whether a wallet can pay gas or a transfer; for ERC-20 tokens use eth_token_balance, for all holdings at once use wallet_portfolio. A malformed address is rejected with 400, uncharged.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: 0x wallet or contract address

get.summary: Ethereum ERC-20 balance
get.description: ERC-20 token balance of a wallet on Ethereum (USDC, USDT, WETH or any token, via balanceOf): raw amount, decimals, symbol and the human-readable amount, live from the token contract. Use to check stablecoin or token holdings before a transfer or trade; for the native coin use eth_balance. Both inputs are 0x addresses (40 hex characters); no contract or a non-ERC-20 contract returns 422, uncharged.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token: a ticker such as USDC, USDT, WETH or DAI, or the 0x ERC-20 contract address

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: 0x wallet address

get.summary: Ethereum transaction
get.description: Look up an Ethereum transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in ETH, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use eth_receipt, for emitted events eth_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 422, uncharged.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: 0x-prefixed transaction hash (64 hex characters)

get.summary: Solana balance: SOL balance of a wallet
get.description: SOL balance of a Solana wallet, read live from mainnet in lamports and SOL, plus its SPL token accounts (mint, symbol for well-known tokens, decimals, amount) when the public node serves them; otherwise tokens is null with a note. Use to check a Solana wallet before a payment. An address that is not 32-byte base58 is 400, uncharged.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Solana wallet address (base58)

get.summary: Crypto price and token price: USD price of a token from Uniswap v3 pools
get.description: Token price in USD for a crypto token by symbol, coin name or CoinGecko id from a built-in list of main tokens (ETH, BTC, USDC, AERO, ARB, OP, LINK, PEPE…) or any ERC-20 0x address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism, from the deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH, read live. Returns pool, fee tier, reserve and a thin-liquidity flag. Spot price; no pool is 422, uncharged. Use to value a token or check a quote before a swap or payment.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker such as ETH, BTC, USDC, AERO, ARB, OP or LINK (instead of address; ETH and BTC mean the wrapped tokens; an HTTP call with no input at all answers for BTC)

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: 0x ERC-20 token contract address (instead of symbol)

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb or op

example.method: Uniswap v3 spot price from the pool with the largest USDC or WETH reserve

get.summary: Crypto prices in USD for up to 20 tokens in one call: get USD prices for several crypto tokens or coins in one call
get.description: USD prices for up to 20 crypto tokens in one call, by ticker (ETH, BTC, LINK, AERO…) or ERC-20 0x address, on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Optimism, each from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH, read live, with pool, reserve and a thin-liquidity flag. With no chain named each ticker is priced on the network that lists it. Tokens without a pool are listed as unpriced. Use to value a basket or refresh a watchlist in one paid call.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Comma-separated tickers such as ETH,BTC,AERO (with or instead of addresses; 1-20 tokens in all; an HTTP call with no input at all answers for BTC and ETH)

parameters.name: addresses
parameters.description: Comma-separated 0x ERC-20 token addresses (with or instead of symbols; 1-20 tokens in all)

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb or op

unpriced.reason: no Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH

example.method: Uniswap v3 spot price from the pool with the largest USDC or WETH reserve

get.summary: Currency exchange rates, forex: currency converter and conversion
get.description: Foreign exchange rates from the European Central Bank for about 30 major currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, SEK, CAD, AUD, CNY, INR, BRL and more). Give a base currency, optionally the target currencies and an amount, and get the rates, the converted amounts and the date the rates apply to. Use for currency conversion, invoice and price calculations, and reporting in another currency.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Base currency as a three-letter ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD (an HTTP call with no input at all answers for USD)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated target currency codes, e.g. EUR,GBP; default is all available currencies

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Optional amount of the base currency to convert (default 1)

example.source: European Central Bank reference rates (one rate per working day, published around 16:00 CET)

InvalidInput.description: Invalid or missing input. Not charged. The body names the inputs and shows a working example.

Unprocessable.description: Nothing exists for this input (code NOT_FOUND: unknown name, address, ID or no data), or the input was understood but could not be processed (for example an unreadable page or a reverted contract call). Not charged.

SourceFailed.description: An outside data source or the target site failed or timed out. Not charged; retry.

Unavailable.description: Temporarily unavailable or at capacity. Not charged; retry after the Retry-After header.

error.description: What went wrong, in plain words

code.description: A stable name for the condition, when it has one (for example TARGET_UNAVAILABLE)

inputs.description: On a 400: the tool's inputs and which are required

example.description: On a 400: a call that works

cardCredits.description: Optional: an adt_ API key bought by card at https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/credits pays any call instead of x402.
